blinding: Search-policy labels masked. Packet still retains candidate self-recommendation statuses and clustered source catalogs; these were ignored in scoring. This is not fully blinded review, and no allocation inference was used.
score_interpretation: Ordinal reviewer judgments of evidence available now, not success probabilities or valuations. Aggregate rank does not override a missing specific-gap/feasibility gate.

candidates.need_and_usefulness: Consequential need for adequately characterized rare-disease cohorts; common prospective measurements could spare patient burden and support several developers.
candidates.novelty_judgment: UNESTABLISHED. RDCA-DAP shares existing data and encourages common new collection. Joint industry funding of new scientific data also has precedents; VISTA is a related preclinical example, not an equivalent longitudinal clinical cohort. This search does not prove a complete prospective financing equivalent.
candidates.technical_judgment: No disease, three actual compatible protocols, recruitment population or endpoint acceptance authority is selected. Mapping public protocols is feasible; demonstrating clinically useful shared evidence is beyond a software-only fixture.
candidates.commercial_judgment: Consent, governance, recruitment expense, sponsor value and free-riding remain unpriced. A consortium template alone does not create an affordable cohort.
candidates.enabling_change_judgment: Agent assistance with protocol comparison is plausible but generic; the packet identifies no newly removable binding cost or minimum viable cohort.
candidates.decisive_next_gate: Name one disease and three independently documented sponsor needs; show a clinically reviewed common measurement set and full prospective collection budget that all three prefer to their outside options.
candidates.falsifier: Incompatible endpoints/populations or an established consortium offering the same study at lower complete cost.

candidates.need_and_usefulness: Reliable essential medicines have high value, but shortage importance does not establish the proposed supply mechanism.
candidates.novelty_judgment: SUBSTANTIALLY ANTICIPATED. Civica already combines long-term purchasing commitments, reserve stock and a rural-hospital program.
candidates.technical_judgment: A readiness option needs one identified, validated licensed production line and a specific uncovered medicine. Neither is supplied.
candidates.commercial_judgment: No restart cost, reservation capacity, lost business or purchaser commitment is established. Financial simulation cannot supply missing licensed capacity.
candidates.enabling_change_judgment: Lower agreement-assembly cost does not remove qualification, production or regulatory constraints.
candidates.decisive_next_gate: Show one unavailable medicine/customer segment and a usable backup line not economically served by existing programs; compare a quoted readiness obligation with inventory and membership.
candidates.falsifier: No legally usable standby capacity or Civica/inventory dominates.

candidates.need_and_usefulness: Smaller utilities may value dependable replacement access and lower reserve carrying cost. GAO participation evidence in the packet supports investigating the segment, not its willingness to pay.
candidates.novelty_judgment: BROAD MECHANISM ALREADY OFFERED. Grid Assurance advertises shared compatible spares, known condition/location, preplanned transport, transparent subscription costs and multi-site restoration. Existing-owner contingent rights differ from its dedicated inventory, but their economic advantage is unestablished.
candidates.technical_judgment: A conflicting-claims checker is buildable. Without actual inventory, condition, transport and correlated-event evidence, a synthetic ledger validates only its supplied rules.
candidates.commercial_judgment: Claiming to serve small utilities is insufficient: eligibility is broad and actual price/coverage differences are unknown. Owner retention can remove the spare exactly when correlated disasters create demand.
candidates.enabling_change_judgment: Agents might reduce heterogeneity and contracting overhead; no measured cost bottleneck or newly feasible reservation is shown.
candidates.decisive_next_gate: Identify a concrete uncovered asset class and at least three real compatible spares/owners, source the competing reserve terms, and demonstrate lower fully funded cost while preserving owner protection. Grid Assurance states its current EHV inventory focuses on 230kV and above; this is a bounded lead, not proof of an underserved lower-voltage market.
candidates.falsifier: Existing reserve access covers the need economically, or owner-retention/logistics constraints destroy pooling surplus.
candidates.disposition: DEFER; highest bounded score, no flagship admission

candidates.need_and_usefulness: Coordinating a viable shared thermal network can enable useful physical infrastructure. NYSERDA and DOE already organize stakeholder engagement, ownership, finance and community coalitions.
candidates.novelty_judgment: UNESTABLISHED. Conditional commitments may improve a particular project, but the packet provides no project whose binding failure is solved by this arrangement and not by existing development contracts.
candidates.technical_judgment: A 12-building synthetic cancellation fixture is executable but cannot identify affordable thermal capacity, easements or real participant reservations.
candidates.commercial_judgment: Financing, physical economics and anchor concentration dominate; no coalition budget or development-fee counterfactual establishes surplus.
candidates.enabling_change_judgment: AI-assisted agreement assembly is plausible incremental operational help; a new productive possibility has not yet been isolated.
candidates.decisive_next_gate: Reconstruct one public pilot with a specific failed or costly commitment dependency and compare existing developer terms with a complete alternative, including anchor withdrawal and cancellation costs.
candidates.falsifier: Ordinary conditional development agreements already address the same risk or project economics remain negative after coordination costs fall.

candidates.need_and_usefulness: Replacement certainty and municipal reimbursement liquidity are substantial barriers; avoiding an unsafe or financially impossible move is valuable.
candidates.novelty_judgment: CORE HOUSING-CLOSING MECHANISM ALREADY PRACTICED. NJ Blue Acres describes replacement housing before closing, voluntary participation until closing, and morning buyout/afternoon replacement closings. A collective bridge guarantee beyond those practices remains a hypothesis.
candidates.technical_judgment: The stated 24,576-case fixture tests researcher-supplied logic, not enforceability, title readiness, grant assignability or insurer availability. I did not access its source because only the two review input files were authorized.
candidates.commercial_judgment: A verified reimbursement bottleneck does not create bridge credit or a risk bearer. Group atomicity can increase cancellation exposure compared with competent concurrent individual closings.
candidates.enabling_change_judgment: Agents can assemble dependency checks; the packet does not show a distinct commitment that an existing escrow coordinator cannot economically execute.
candidates.decisive_next_gate: Identify a program where ordinary concurrent closings fail due to a specified financing gap; establish permissible financing, an actual willing risk bearer and capped costs, preserving independent household consent.
candidates.falsifier: Concurrent closings already meet the need, required guarantees cannot be supplied, or collective cancellation and finance costs exceed avoided delay.
candidates.disposition: REJECT current flagship formulation; retain unverified bridge-finance subproblem

candidates.need_and_usefulness: Reliable vehicle departures despite constrained electricity are valuable. The useful outcome is transport availability, not charger scheduling alone.
candidates.novelty_judgment: SUBSTANTIAL INCUMBENT OVERLAP. Highland advertises performance guarantees, route-ready charging, backup storage and temporary generation. These sources do not establish an identical multi-operator fallback contract under a specific non-firm connection, so that narrower claim remains unresolved.
candidates.technical_judgment: A service-obligation simulator is feasible, but no actual curtailment envelope, duty cycle and exclusively reservable fallback capacity are joined here.
candidates.commercial_judgment: A guarantor must fund correlated fallback capacity and tail losses. No premium, capital requirement or incumbent offer comparison yet supports a new market.
candidates.enabling_change_judgment: Agents may coordinate existing services more cheaply; a bounded uncovered service requirement has not been identified.
candidates.decisive_next_gate: Specify one real non-firm connection and fleet service requirement that a competent electrification provider does not cover; verify alternative operator capacity and price the correlated obligation.
candidates.falsifier: A vendor already guarantees the same operation economically or one common outage makes reserved fallbacks simultaneously unavailable.

reason: All six concern consequential needs, but none yet establishes a specific economically important failure of the strongest existing approach together with available inputs for a decisive construction. Four have substantial mechanism overlap with actual offerings/practices; the other two lack a concrete disease/project and a discriminating acceptance test. A typed ledger, escrow state machine or synthetic common-failure test would demonstrate supplied-rule execution, not by itself a newly achievable productive opportunity.
what_is_missing: One bounded user/asset/disease/project whose useful outcome is presently blocked, with the closest competent incumbent arrangement documented.
An explicit restriction the proposed mechanism actually changes, rather than a claim that organizations do not coordinate or validate.
Accessible facts or defensible calibrated parameters for a decisive construction preserving all original obligations and a conventional controller given the same formulation.
A complete risk-bearer/financing participation case; refundable deposits and hypothetical guarantees cannot stand in for capital or usable capacity.
Evidence that changed agent capability removes a material bottleneck. The current proposals mostly assert lower assembly cost without measuring or calibrating its importance.
smallest_further_probe_if_search_continu: Investigate the narrowest documented uncovered segment rather than expanding a simulator: for example, C03 explicitly outside the incumbent EHV class with actual compatible owner-held spares, or C05 an identified lawful reimbursement bridge absent from existing concurrent closing. These are research leads, not selected opportunities.
discovery_comparison_boundary: No conclusion about ordinary versus expert search follows until allocation is separately unblinded after this review. One paired search with six proposals cannot establish a general numerical Operational Alpha effect.
